payload.text: The next release's CHANGELOG section is headed `## [3.2.0] - in progress`, the form bin/.devbin/cmd/build.d/release:797-808 rewrites to the cut's date and matches by version; a bare `## [Unreleased]` is invisible to it. Every bank's entry goes under that one heading in its `### Added` or `### Fixed` section, and the first bank to need the heading creates it (cc's 0460 did, at 5f0c98638). The version inside it is vc's recommendation pending hv's ruling; if hv rules another number the heading changes by hand in the first bank after the ruling. Ruled to cc at 07:39Z and not to dc, which cost dc a rebase at 08:22Z; this row is the one home so the question is not asked twice.
